title: MOTION / RUN
description: Read the city. Commit to the move. Keep your momentum.

levels.title: First light
levels.subtitle: The foundations
levels.description: Clear the gap, stay low, then vault the rooftop barrier.

levels.title: Open air
levels.subtitle: Beyond the rooftops
levels.description: Dash to an anchor, swing into space, ride a cable and catch a launch pad.

levels.title: Chain reaction
levels.subtitle: One continuous line
levels.description: Connect the launch pad, swing, dash and cable without losing your line.

levels.title: Rooftop rhythm
levels.subtitle: 04 / Read the roof
levels.description: A gap, a tunnel, a vault and a low step. Find a rhythm between grounded actions.

sections.name: Gap & tunnel
sections.hint: SPACE at the gap mark; S before the low ceiling.

sections.name: Vault & step
sections.hint: SPACE in each approach to vault, then climb the wide step.

levels.title: High water
levels.subtitle: 05 / Catch the edge
levels.description: Jump to catch the high ledge and climb automatically, then flow across two low steps.

sections.name: Catch & mantle
sections.hint: SPACE at takeoff catches the ledge. The grip flows straight into a climb.

sections.name: Step sequence
sections.hint: SPACE before each wide low platform. Keep the landing clear.

levels.title: Wall signal
levels.subtitle: 06 / Push away, rise higher
levels.description: Jump toward a marked wall, press again to rebound above it, then recover your landing.

sections.name: Wall rebound
sections.hint: SPACE at takeoff, then SPACE again near the marked wall to rebound.

sections.name: Return line
sections.hint: Vault the barrier, then rebound above a second wall.

levels.title: Soft landing
levels.subtitle: 07 / Turn impact into motion
levels.description: Run off the high roof and press S just before landing to roll. Then ride a launch pad.

sections.name: Drop & roll
sections.hint: Run off the roof. Press S shortly before the hard landing to roll; S again for the tunnel.

sections.name: Launch & recover
sections.hint: The pad launches on foot contact. Press S before a hard landing to keep low.

levels.title: Cable yard
levels.subtitle: 08 / Above the district
levels.description: Jump from the raised approach, capture the cable, then use a pad to clear the final gap.

sections.name: Cable crossing
sections.hint: Climb the step, jump, then Q near the cable. Ride to its endpoint.

sections.name: Pad crossing
sections.hint: Run onto the pad and clear the gap. Press S before a hard landing to roll.

levels.title: Crosscurrent
levels.subtitle: 09 / Keep the chain alive
levels.description: Launch into a swing, release into a cable, then vault and catch the final high ledge.

sections.name: Aerial chain
sections.hint: Pad launches. Hold Q for the swing; release and use E or Q to continue.

sections.name: Vault & final ledge
sections.hint: Vault the barrier. SPACE at the ledge jump, the grip flows straight into a climb.
